page_title: STU 4-0 WOL | Stuttgart v Wolfsburg 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Patrick Ittrich is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' 4 - 0 Tiago Tomas passes the ball into the penalty area. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) collects it and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 4:0!
90+3' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+3' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.
90+2' Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
90+1' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Alexander Nubel, who makes a comfortable save.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
88' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Bilal El Khannouss will be replaced by Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart).
88' A substitution has been made. Chris Fuhrich goes off and Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
88' The referee shows a yellow card to Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
85' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
85' Jeanuel Belocian is being substituted because of an injury. Daniel Bauer sends Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) on the pitch.
84' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

83' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
81' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
79' The attendance is 60000.
77' Jamie Leweling goes off the pitch and Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
77' Here is a change. Deniz Undav is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart).

71' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
68' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
68' The substitution is prepared. Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Jaquez.
68' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Patrick Ittrich who sees an offensive foul.
66' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
63' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
62' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) replaces Pharell Hensel.
58' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes it short.
58' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
57' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alexander Nubel.
54' Wolfsburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

50' Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
50' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
48' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) picks up an injury.

47' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
47' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jonas Adjetey comes on the pitch for Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
46' Daniel Bauer has made a change at the break. Dzenan Pejcinovic has come on in place of Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
46' Half-time substitution. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) will not participate anymore and Kento Shiogai is coming on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.
45+1' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper. Stuttgart have a corner.
45' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' 3 - 0 Goal! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 3:0.
42' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Stuttgart.
41' This shall not pass! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
39' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
39' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Stuttgart win a corner.
36' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off the line to clear the ball away.

34' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
33' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Patrick Ittrich stops the game and makes a call. Stuttgart earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! Chris Fuhrich rounded the goalkeeper and sent a sweet pass to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart), who had an easy finish to put it into an empty net. 2:0.
29' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
28' Rough tackle by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

25' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
24' The foul by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Patrick Ittrich who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
19' Daniel Bauer isn't happy on the touchline after referee Patrick Ittrich shows him a yellow card.
17' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
17' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg). The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Pharell Hensel (Wolfsburg) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
15' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.

15' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the right side of the goal lacks power and Kamil Grabara easily makes the save.
14' Stuttgart are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
6' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Kamil Grabara's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
6' The game is interrupted as Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is flagged offside.
5' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
4' Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball goes out of play. Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
4' Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg).
2' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
2' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball into the box and Deniz Undav takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Stuttgart will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Patrick Ittrich.
